adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler decrypts `reqBody.keys`, does `JSON.parse(...)`, and writes the result directly into `prisma.credential.update/create` as `key` without validating it against any per-app credential schema (it only looks up `appMetadata.slug/type`). This is a real diff-grounded robustness concern: malformed-but-JSON payloads can be persisted and later consumers may fail. However, the claim that it "will blow up at booking time" and that the endpoint will still return 200 in a specific failing scenario is not directly verifiable from the diff alone (depends on downstream usage/spec).
